newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil BNDES appeals other CVRD injunctions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDES appeals other CVRD injunctions.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) has appealed a second injunction halting the sale of Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a judicial official said.

The official at the Regional Federal Tribunal (TRF) in Rio de Janeiro said the court's president was now studying petitions against two injunctions, one which halted bidding midway and the other which was issued after the auction was suspended.
Sources at the BNDES said they were confident the court's decision would go their way and that the sell-off would resume today.
One relatively high-ranking source said the bank believed the TRF ruling would also deter further similar lawsuits.
The sale of up to 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares had been on hold since April 29 because of a flurry of court orders.
After winning a key high court ruling Monday night and succeeding in quashing three outstanding injunctions this morning, the government rushed to start the auction at midday.
But the bidding was dramatically interrupted when a court official charged onto the bolsa floor waving a new injunction.
